title: Authority boundaries
summary: The broker separates requesting LLM, human approver, public-key verifier/execution node and qualification worker. It is not a remote shell.
invariants: LLMs select only operator-catalogued identities, never arbitrary paths or commands.
Human approval does not grant login or general execution authority.
Worker execution transition is not dispatched through MCP.
Authentication of the LLM and authorization by the human are distinct authorities.
